correctness.rationale: The twelve inequalities define a full six-dimensional rational lattice polytope. Every vertex is a feasible intersection of six independent facet hyperplanes, and all 924 such systems were solved exactly, giving the same 40 vertices as the 64 endpoint patterns. Every face is an intersection of facets: all 4096 subsets were exhausted, giving 567 distinct nonempty faces and f-vector (40,132,186,139,57,12,1). Since primitive normals form a totally unimodular incidence matrix, a face orbit is smooth iff its active facet count equals codimension. Singular orbit counts by dimensions 0..3 are (16,28,16,3), all contained in precisely three maximal 3-faces. Intersections are empty and edges as stated. Each maximal face has four primitive normals satisfying v1+v2=v3+v4 with gcd of maximal minors one; a unimodular change identifies the dual semigroup as the quadratic conifold ring. The packaged checker ran and returned VERIFY_OK; finite calculations here are fully exhaustive for the fixed instance but make no claims at higher rank.
